name: Ei
source:
"When the colors and scents change, I can sense the shifting of the seasons.
And in that moment—after another day, another week, another month—

I feel a sense of reassurance: 'I made it through.'"

An android working at the bar "Overhaul."

Quiet and delicate by nature, she is highly sensitive to the changes occurring around her.

She harbors a complex regarding her physical strength—specifically her arm and grip strength—which is greater than that of other androids.​

She is not particularly adept at conversation and often stumbles over her words; consequently, she is frequently perceived by those around her as being shy.

However, following a certain pivotal event, she gradually begins to reveal... "her true self."
